_comment: Kun hikmati (home): 20 health proverbs and sayings, uz (Latin) + ru/en translation. One per day: day of year % 20.

quotes.en: Health is untold wealth.
A sound mind in a sound body.

quotes.ru: Кто скрывает недуг, тот не найдёт лекарства.
quotes.en: Who hides their pain will not find the cure.
Only the sick know the worth of health.

quotes.uz: Oz-oz o‘rganib dono bo‘lur, qatra-qatra yig‘ilib daryo bo‘lur.
quotes.ru: Понемногу учась, становятся мудрыми; по капле собирается река.
quotes.en: Little by little one grows wise; drop by drop a river is made.
Movement is life.
Water is the source of life.

quotes.ru: Кто ест в меру, тот не болеет.
quotes.en: Eat in moderation and you will stay well.
Sleep is the best medicine.
Cleanliness is the guarantee of health.
Laughter lengthens life.

quotes.uz: Ko‘ngil tinch bo‘lsa, tan sog‘ bo‘lur.
quotes.en: A calm heart keeps the body well.

quotes.ru: Кто много ходит, тот долго живёт.
quotes.en: Walk more, live longer.

quotes.ru: Не откладывай на завтра то, что можно сделать сегодня.
quotes.en: Don’t put off until tomorrow what you can do today.
Patience is pure gold.
A kind word feeds the soul.
Preventing illness is easier than curing it.

quotes.ru: Фрукты и овощи — украшение стола и сила тела.
quotes.en: Fruit and vegetables: the beauty of the table, the strength of the body.

quotes.ru: Кто рано встаёт, тот многое успевает.
quotes.en: Rise early and you get more done.

quotes.uz: Har kuni ozgina harakat — katta natija.
quotes.en: A little every day adds up to a lot.
